role: Defines the typed value union every fact resolver returns (FactValue), its structured absence reasons (MissingReason), per-fact availability metadata (Availability), human-readable renderers and the JSON tool_result envelope sent back to LLM providers.
types: MissingReason: enum (String, Codable) — 9 structured absence reasons (notRecorded, notYetComputed, outOfRange, sensorDropout, invalidParameter, internalError, tooMuchData, rateLimited, partialData)
Availability: struct — hasData / validRange / lastUpdated for schema-build gating; statics alwaysAvailable, unavailable, workouts(in:)
FactValue: enum — integer/double/string/date/durationSec/boolean/missing(reason,detail)/list/record with rendering and JSON envelope
AnyFactJSON: struct (private, Encodable) — wraps Foundation values for JSONEncoder with sortedKeys
toplevel: Static lets Availability.alwaysAvailable (hasData true, nil range) and Availability.unavailable (hasData false). FactValue and Availability are Sendable; MissingReason is Codable with raw string values used on the wire.

flags.text: Doc comment says .string renders 'quoted, truncated for display if very long', but humanReadable returns the raw string unquoted and untruncated.

units.does: Builds Availability for workout-backed namespaces from the in-memory SessionArchive: unavailable when no entry has sessionType .workout, otherwise hasData true with validRange earliest...latest workout date and lastUpdated = latest.

branches.cond: archive holds at least one workout entry
branches.effect: false: returns .unavailable; true: continues to compute date range

branches.cond: min and max of the workout dates exist
branches.effect: true: returns Availability(hasData: true, validRange: earliest...latest, lastUpdated: latest); false: returns .alwaysAvailable (unreachable because line 86 guaranteed a non-empty date list)

flags.text: The `guard let earliest = dates.min(), let latest = dates.max() else { return .alwaysAvailable }` fallback can never run: the preceding guard ensured at least one workout, so dates is non-empty.

units.does: Formats a Double for display: integral values as '%.0f', otherwise '%.2f' with a regex stripping an optional decimal point and trailing zeros (5.20 -> '5.2', 5.00x -> '5').

branches.effect: true: String(format: "%.0f"); false: two-decimal string with trailing zeros/point removed by regex \.?0+$

branches.effect: renders unknown (reason) with detail appended when present

units.does: Encodes envelope() through JSONEncoder (.sortedKeys) via AnyFactJSON to a UTF-8 JSON string used as the cloud-provider tool_result content; falls back to a fixed internalError JSON literal when encoding or UTF-8 decoding fails.

branches.cond: encode succeeded and data decodes as UTF-8
branches.effect: true: returns the JSON string; false: returns '{"missingReason":"internalError","detail":"encoding failed"}' (attempt() logs the thrown error); this fallback lacks the 'value' key the envelope contract promises

flags.text: toolResultJSON (JSONEncoder + AnyFactJSON) and toToolResultJSON() (JSONSerialization) serialise the same envelope() with two different encoders and two different failure literals; tests at FactValueTests.swift:385-400 exist only to keep them in step.

units.does: Serialises envelope() with JSONSerialization (.sortedKeys) for the Apple Foundation tool path; returns a fixed internalError JSON when the dictionary is not a valid JSON object or serialisation throws, and '{}' if UTF-8 decoding fails.

branches.cond: env is a valid JSON object and JSONSerialization succeeds
branches.effect: false: returns '{"value":null,"missingReason":"internalError","detail":"FactValue not JSON-serialisable"}' (error swallowed by try?); true: continues
non-nil string returned; nil -> '{}' (an envelope with no fields)

units.does: Builds the wire envelope dictionary: asOf = localISO8601(now), confidence = 'high', and either value = NSNull + missingReason (+detail) for .missing, or value = toAnyJSON() otherwise.

units.does: Recursively converts the FactValue tree into Foundation JSON types: Int, Double (non-finite -> NSNull), String, ISO date string, duration seconds Int, Bool, nested missing -> full envelope dict, list -> [Any], record -> [String: Any].

units.does: Formats a Date as ISO 8601 with colon-separated current local UTC offset (e.g. 2026-04-21T19:30:00-07:00) using a fresh Date.ISO8601FormatStyle each call.
Formats seconds as 'Hh Mm Ss' when >= 1h, 'Mm SSs' when >= 1 min, else 'Ss'.

flags.text: The FactValue doc says .duration renders as "63m 07s", but formatDuration switches to an hours form at 3600 s: 3787 s renders "1h 3m 7s". Minutes are zero-padded only when there is no hour part.
